What we do

Complete care, right at your doorstep.

Every plan begins with a conversation. From skilled nursing to personal daily support, we build care around the patient and the people who love them.

Skilled nursing

Registered nurses and licensed vocational nurses provide wound care, IV therapy, injections, tube feedings, medication management, and close monitoring of changing conditions.

Ask about nursing care→

Physical, occupational & speech therapy

Rehabilitation at home helps patients rebuild strength, balance, mobility, and communication after surgery, illness, or injury.

Learn about therapy→

Dementia & Alzheimer's care

Specialized support for memory-related conditions, focusing on safety, routine, communication, and family education through every stage.

Explore memory care→

Home health aides

Trained aides assist with bathing, dressing, grooming, light meal preparation, and daily activities under nurse supervision.

Meet our aides→

Medical social work

Our social workers connect families to community resources, entitlements, counseling, and the emotional support needed during complex care.

Talk to a social worker→

Not sure what you need?

Tell us what is happening. We will help you understand your options, coordinate with your physician, and build a plan that fits.

Start a conversation

About us

There is no better place to heal than where you feel safest.

Cornerstone Home Health was built on a simple belief: patients recover better, live fuller, and stay longer at home when care is delivered with skill and genuine compassion.

We serve Rockport, Portland, Corpus Christi, and surrounding Coastal Bend communities with physician-directed skilled nursing, rehabilitation therapies, and personal support services.

  • ✓Physician orders and personalized care plans
  • ✓Licensed nurses, therapists, aides, and social workers
  • ✓24/7 on-call clinical support
  • ✓Local ownership and community roots
Get to know our team

Why families choose us

Local care. National standards. Personal attention.

01

Joint Commission accredited

We meet rigorous national standards for quality and safety in home care, so families can trust the care their loved ones receive.

02

Coastal Bend born and staffed

Our caregivers live here. They understand the local health network, the rhythm of coastal life, and the value of showing up on time.

03

Care built around family

We do not just treat a chart. We listen to patients, support caregivers, and communicate clearly with physicians and loved ones.

04

Available when you need us

Home health needs do not follow office hours. Our team is reachable around the clock for questions, concerns, and urgent changes.

What does skilled nursing care include at home?

Medication management for seniors at home

Accreditation

What Joint Commission accreditation means for your family
